title: ever JORDANE|Spaghetti Strap Cold Shoulder Chiffon A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Dance the night away in our Spaghetti Strap Cold Shoulder Chiffon A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress. The playful cold-shoulder design and spaghetti straps add a touch of allure, while the flowing chiffon fabric creates a graceful A-line silhouette. Perfect for wedding guests, this midi dress combines style and comfort for a memorable celebration.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
